verses.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then Job answered and said:

verses.he: שִׁמְע֣וּ שָׁ֭מוֹעַ מִלָּתִ֑י וּתְהִי־זֹ֝֗את תַּנְח֥וּמֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.en: Hear diligently my speech; And let this be your consolations.

verses.he: שָׂ֭אוּנִי וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְאַחַ֖ר דַּבְּרִ֣י תַלְעִֽיג׃
verses.en: Suffer me, that I may speak; And after that I have spoken, mock on.

verses.he: הֶ֭אָנֹכִי לְאָדָ֣ם שִׂיחִ֑י וְאִם־מַ֝דּ֗וּעַ לֹא־תִקְצַ֥ר רוּחִֽי׃
verses.en: As for me, is my complaint to man? Or why should I not be impatient?

verses.he: פְּנוּ־אֵלַ֥י וְהָשַׁ֑מּוּ וְשִׂ֖ימוּ יָ֣ד עַל־פֶּֽה׃
verses.en: Turn unto me, and be astonished, And lay your hand upon your mouth.

verses.he: וְאִם־זָכַ֥רְתִּי וְנִבְהָ֑לְתִּי וְאָחַ֥ז בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗י פַּלָּצֽוּת׃
verses.en: Even when I remember I am affrighted, And horror hath taketh hold on my flesh.

verses.he: מַדּ֣וּעַ רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִחְי֑וּ עָ֝תְק֗וּ גַּם־גָּ֥בְרוּ חָֽיִל׃
verses.en: Wherefore do the wicked live, Become old, yea, wax mighty in power?

verses.he: זַרְעָ֤ם נָכ֣וֹן לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם עִמָּ֑ם וְ֝צֶאֱצָאֵיהֶ֗ם לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Their seed is established in their sight with them, And their offspring before their eyes.

verses.he: בָּתֵּיהֶ֣ם שָׁל֣וֹם מִפָּ֑חַד וְלֹ֤א שֵׁ֖בֶט אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Their houses are safe, without fear, Neither is the rod of God upon them.

verses.he: שׁוֹר֣וֹ עִ֭בַּר וְלֹ֣א יַגְעִ֑ל תְּפַלֵּ֥ט פָּ֝רָת֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א תְשַׁכֵּֽל׃
verses.en: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; Their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.

verses.he: יְשַׁלְּח֣וּ כַ֭צֹּאן עֲוִילֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝יַלְדֵיהֶ֗ם יְרַקֵּדֽוּן׃
verses.en: They send forth their little ones like a flock, And their children dance.

verses.he: יִ֭שְׂאוּ כְּתֹ֣ף וְכִנּ֑וֹר וְ֝יִשְׂמְח֗וּ לְק֣וֹל עוּגָֽב׃
verses.en: They sing to the timbrel and harp, And rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

verses.he: יבלו [יְכַלּ֣וּ] בַטּ֣וֹב יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וּ֝בְרֶ֗גַע שְׁא֣וֹל יֵחָֽתּוּ׃
verses.en: They spend their days in prosperity, And peacefully they go down to the grave.

verses.he: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לָ֭אֵל ס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְדַ֥עַת דְּ֝רָכֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א חָפָֽצְנוּ׃
verses.en: Yet they said unto God: ‘Depart from us; For we desire not the knowledge of Thy ways.

verses.he: מַה־שַׁדַּ֥י כִּֽי־נַֽעַבְדֶ֑נּוּ וּמַה־נּ֝וֹעִ֗יל כִּ֣י נִפְגַּע־בּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: What is the Almighty, that we should serve Him? And what profit should we have, if we pray unto Him?’—

verses.he: הֵ֤ן לֹ֣א בְיָדָ֣ם טוּבָ֑ם עֲצַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים רָ֣חֲקָה מֶֽנִּי׃
verses.en: Lo, their prosperity is not in their hand; The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

verses.he: כַּמָּ֤ה׀ נֵר־רְשָׁ֘עִ֤ים יִדְעָ֗ךְ וְיָבֹ֣א עָלֵ֣ימוֹ אֵידָ֑ם חֲ֝בָלִ֗ים יְחַלֵּ֥ק בְּאַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: How oft is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out? That their calamity cometh upon them? That He distributeth pains in His anger?

verses.he: יִהְי֗וּ כְּתֶ֥בֶן לִפְנֵי־ר֑וּחַ וּ֝כְמֹ֗ץ גְּנָבַ֥תּוּ סוּפָֽה׃
verses.en: That they are as stubble before the wind, And as chaff that the storm stealeth away?

verses.he: אֱל֗וֹהַּ יִצְפֹּן־לְבָנָ֥יו אוֹנ֑וֹ יְשַׁלֵּ֖ם אֵלָ֣יו וְיֵדָֽע׃
verses.en: ’God layeth up his iniquity for his children! ’— Let Him recompense it unto himself, that he may know it.

verses.he: יִרְא֣וּ עינו [עֵינָ֣יו] כִּיד֑וֹ וּמֵחֲמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י יִשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.en: Let his own eyes see his destruction, And let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

verses.he: כִּ֤י מַה־חֶפְצ֣וֹ בְּבֵית֣וֹ אַחֲרָ֑יו וּמִסְפַּ֖ר חֳדָשָׁ֣יו חֻצָּֽצוּ׃
verses.en: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him? Seeing the number of his months is determined.

verses.he: הַלְאֵ֥ל יְלַמֶּד־דָּ֑עַת וְ֝ה֗וּא רָמִ֥ים יִשְׁפּֽוֹט׃
verses.en: Shall any teach God knowledge? Seeing it is He that judgeth those that are high.

verses.he: זֶ֗ה יָ֭מוּת בְּעֶ֣צֶם תֻּמּ֑וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗וֹ שַׁלְאֲנַ֥ן וְשָׁלֵֽיו׃
verses.en: One dieth in his full strength, Being wholly at ease and quiet;

verses.he: עֲ֭טִינָיו מָלְא֣וּ חָלָ֑ב וּמֹ֖חַ עַצְמוֹתָ֣יו יְשֻׁקֶּֽה׃
verses.en: His pails are full of milk, And the marrow of his bones is moistened.

verses.he: וְזֶ֗ה יָ֭מוּת בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ מָרָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־אָ֝כַ֗ל בַּטּוֹבָֽה׃
verses.en: And another dieth in bitterness of soul, And hath never tasted of good.

verses.he: יַ֭חַד עַל־עָפָ֣ר יִשְׁכָּ֑בוּ וְ֝רִמָּ֗ה תְּכַסֶּ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: They lie down alike in the dust, And the worm covereth them.

verses.he: הֵ֣ן יָ֭דַעְתִּי מַחְשְׁבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וּ֝מְזִמּ֗וֹת עָלַ֥י תַּחְמֹֽסוּ׃
verses.en: Behold, I know your thoughts, And the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.

verses.he: כִּ֤י תֹֽאמְר֗וּ אַיֵּ֥ה בֵית־נָדִ֑יב וְ֝אַיֵּ֗ה אֹ֤הֶל׀ מִשְׁכְּנ֬וֹת רְשָׁעִֽים׃
verses.en: For ye say: ‘Where is the house of the prince? And where is the tent wherein the wicked dwelt?’

verses.he: הֲלֹ֣א שְׁ֭אֶלְתֶּם ע֣וֹבְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ וְ֝אֹתֹתָ֗ם לֹ֣א תְנַכֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.en: Have ye not asked them that go by the way; And will ye misdeem their tokens,

verses.he: כִּ֤י לְי֣וֹם אֵ֭יד יֵחָ֣שֶׂךְ רָ֑ע לְי֖וֹם עֲבָר֣וֹת יוּבָֽלוּ׃
verses.en: That the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led forth to the day of wrath?

verses.he: מִֽי־יַגִּ֣יד עַל־פָּנָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְהֽוּא־עָ֝שָׂ֗ה מִ֣י יְשַׁלֶּם־לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: But who shall declare his way to his face? And who shall repay him what he hath done?

verses.he: וְ֭הוּא לִקְבָר֣וֹת יוּבָ֑ל וְֽעַל־גָּדִ֥ישׁ יִשְׁקֽוֹד׃
verses.en: For he is borne to the grave, And watch is kept over his tomb.

verses.he: מָֽתְקוּ־ל֗וֹ רִגְבֵ֫י נָ֥חַל וְ֭אַחֲרָיו כָּל־אָדָ֣ם יִמְשׁ֑וֹךְ וּ֝לְפָנָ֗יו אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.en: The clods of the valley are sweet unto him, And all men draw after him, As there were innumerable before him.

verses.he: וְ֭אֵיךְ תְּנַחֲמ֣וּנִי הָ֑בֶל וּ֝תְשֽׁוּבֹתֵיכֶ֗ם נִשְׁאַר־מָֽעַל׃
verses.en: How then comfort ye me in vain? And as for your answers, there remaineth only faithlessness?
